  "canonical_python_code": "import numpy as np


def calibrate_affine(checks: np.ndarray, *, stress_scale: float,
                     command_scale: float | None = None, command_origin: float = 0.0,
                     prior: tuple[float, float] | None = None,
                     historical: tuple[np.ndarray, ...] = (), residual_gate: float = 0.003,
                     pair_span: float = 0.12, strong_span: float = 0.35) -> tuple[np.ndarray, float]:
    """Return physical [gain, bias] and current-panel support (>=1 is strong).

    Rows are (command, measured stress) from a single affine instrument.
    Supply characteristic scales, not the range of a sparse panel. Historical
    panels belong to that instrument and are ordered newest first. The optional
    peer line is in input units; the default anchor is normalized identity.
    Dimensionless consensus gates and fallback to an anchored slope control
    the fit on weak panels rather than applying a coefficient penalty.
    """
    cs = stress_scale if command_scale is None else command_scale
    if not (0 < cs < np.inf and 0 < stress_scale < np.inf and
            0 < pair_span <= strong_span < np.inf and 0 < residual_gate < np.inf):
        raise ValueError('invalid calibration scales or gates')
    seed = (np.array([1., 0.]) if prior is None else
            np.array([prior[0] * cs / stress_scale,
                      (prior[0] * command_origin + prior[1]) / stress_scale]))

    def rows(panel: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
        p = np.asarray(panel, float).reshape(-1, 2)
        p = p[np.isfinite(p).all(axis=1)]
        return (p[:, 0] - command_origin) / cs, p[:, 1] / stress_scale

    def refit(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        dx = x - x.mean()
        gain = (dx @ (y - y.mean())) / (dx @ dx)
        return np.array([gain, y.mean() - gain * x.mean()])

    def consensus(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, anchor: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int, float]:
        i, j = np.triu_indices(x.size, 1)
        keep = np.abs(x[j] - x[i]) >= pair_span
        i, j = i[keep], j[keep]
        slope = (y[j] - y[i]) / (x[j] - x[i])
        candidates = np.vstack((np.column_stack((slope, y[i] - slope*x[i])), anchor))
        r = np.abs(y - candidates[:, :1]*x - candidates[:, 1:]) / residual_gate
        masks = r <= 1
        count = masks.sum(axis=1)
        cost = np.sum(np.minimum(r, 1)**2, axis=1)
        distance = np.sum((candidates - anchor)**2, axis=1)
        best = np.lexsort((cost, distance*(count < 3), -count))[0]
        m = masks[best]
        width = float(np.ptp(x[m])) if m.any() else 0.
        fit = refit(x[m], y[m]) if width >= pair_span else anchor.copy()
        return fit, int(count[best]), width

    x, y = rows(checks)
    line, count, width = consensus(x, y, seed)
    support = float(min(count / max(3, (x.size + 1)//2), width / strong_span))
    if support < 1:
        anchor, archived = seed.copy(), False
        for panel in historical:
            hx, hy = rows(panel)
            fit, n, span = consensus(hx, hy, seed)
            if n >= 3 and span >= strong_span:
                anchor, archived = fit, True
                break
        line = anchor.copy()
        if not archived and x.size == 2 and np.ptp(x) >= strong_span:
            line = refit(x, y)
        elif x.size:
            shift = y - anchor[0]*x - anchor[1]
            center = np.median(shift)
            agree = np.abs(shift - center) <= residual_gate
            n = agree.sum()
            if n > x.size//2 and (n >= 2 or not archived or abs(center) <= residual_gate):
                if not archived and n >= 2 and np.ptp(x[agree]) >= strong_span:
                    line, _, _ = consensus(x[agree], y[agree], anchor)
                else:
                    line[1] += shift[agree].mean()
    gain = line[0] * stress_scale / cs
    return np.array([gain, line[1]*stress_scale - gain*command_origin]), support


def align_reference_features(raw: np.ndarray, reference: np.ndarray,
                             groups: np.ndarray, strata: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return dimensionless aligned features and an original completeness mask.

    Reference and signal share an additive offset and positive gain within each
    group. Normalize by the medians of reference-column means and population
    standard deviations. Zero spread is unsupported; there is no gain floor.
    Fill from the same group and stratum, then from equally weighted observed
    stratum means within the group, then from the reference origin if necessary.
    Supplied cohorts may share a group only if their unlabeled panels share the
    reference gauge and are available at inference.
    """
    raw, reference = np.asarray(raw, float), np.asarray(reference, float)
    groups, strata = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(strata)
    if (raw.ndim != 2 or reference.ndim != 2 or reference.shape[0] != len(raw)
            or groups.shape != (len(raw),) or strata.shape != groups.shape):
        raise ValueError('reference, group and stratum rows must match raw features')
    levels, index = np.unique(groups, return_inverse=True)
    index = index.reshape(-1)
    out = np.empty_like(raw)
    for g in range(levels.size):
        take = index == g
        r = reference[take]
        r = np.where(np.isfinite(r), r, np.nan)
        r = r[:, np.isfinite(r).any(axis=0)]
        if not r.shape[1]:
            raise ValueError('group lacks observed reference data')
        center = np.median(np.nanmean(r, axis=0))
        spread = np.median(np.nanstd(r, axis=0, ddof=0))
        if not (0 < spread < np.inf):
            raise ValueError('group reference spread must be finite and positive')
        x = (raw[take] - center) / spread
        x = np.where(np.isfinite(x), x, np.nan)
        _, cell = np.unique(strata[take], return_inverse=True)
        cell = cell.reshape(-1)
        means = np.full((cell.max()+1, x.shape[1]), np.nan)
        for j in range(len(means)):
            block = x[cell == j]
            count = np.isfinite(block).sum(axis=0)
            np.divide(np.nansum(block, axis=0), count, out=means[j], where=count > 0)
        count = np.isfinite(means).sum(axis=0)
        fallback = np.divide(np.nansum(means, axis=0), count,
                             out=np.zeros(x.shape[1]), where=count > 0)
        fill = np.where(np.isfinite(means[cell]), means[cell], fallback)
        out[take] = np.where(np.isfinite(x), x, fill)
    return out, np.isfinite(raw).all(axis=1)


def hereditary_creep(history_dt: np.ndarray, hold_times: np.ndarray,
                     stress_history: np.ndarray, hold_stress: np.ndarray,
                     initial_memory: np.ndarray, features: np.ndarray, groups: np.ndarray,
                     complete: np.ndarray, strain_0: np.ndarray, onset_obs: np.ndarray,
                     critical_strain: np.ndarray, *, time_scale: float, stress_scale: float,
                     strain_scale: float, yield_stress: float, stress_floor: float,
                     strain_increment: np.ndarray | None = None,
                     model: tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray] | None = None,
                     tau_limits: tuple[float, float] = (0.2, 8.0), late_time_ratio: float = 1.,
                     rank_tol: float = 1e-8) -> tuple[tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray],
                                                      np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Fit or predict two ordered hereditary branches and additive linear drift.

    History uses chronological piecewise-constant sub-yield stresses and shared
    durations. Initial memory is stress-valued, with fast then slow columns.
    The model contains physical time constants, physical coefficients, group
    labels, and normalized group corrections (center, offset, slope). The first
    two coefficients have strain/stress units; the others (intercept, then
    features) have strain/time units. Retain the fitted normalization when
    reusing the model, scaling the physical parameters when changing units.

    Fit on complete rows with increments and onset. Predict with a fitted model;
    unseen groups use global drift, while incomplete rows use independent onset
    in strain/time. There is no coefficient penalty: robust loss, ordered
    bounds in units of time_scale, and a local Jacobian rank screen constrain
    the fit. The late window starts at late_time_ratio times time_scale.

    Return the model, absolute strain, terminal secant compliance, first
    grid-interpolated threshold crossing, and event flag. A noncrossing row
    returns the final horizon with a false event flag.
    """
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares

    scales = np.array([time_scale, stress_scale, strain_scale, yield_stress, stress_floor])
    lo, hi = tau_limits
    if not (np.isfinite(scales).all() and np.all(scales > 0) and
            0 < lo < hi < np.inf and 0 < rank_tol < 1 and 0 < late_time_ratio < np.inf):
        raise ValueError('invalid physical scales or fitting bounds')
    dt = np.asarray(history_dt, float) / time_scale
    t = np.asarray(hold_times, float) / time_scale
    hist = np.asarray(stress_history, float) / stress_scale
    hold = np.asarray(hold_stress, float) / stress_scale
    z0 = np.asarray(initial_memory, float) / stress_scale
    x = np.asarray(features, float)
    groups, complete = np.asarray(groups), np.asarray(complete, bool)
    start = np.asarray(strain_0, float)
    onset = np.asarray(onset_obs, float) * time_scale / strain_scale
    critical = np.asarray(critical_strain, float)
    n, k = hold.size, t.size
    if (not n or not k or dt.ndim != 1 or t.shape != (k,) or hist.shape != (n, dt.size)
            or z0.shape != (n, 2) or x.ndim != 2 or x.shape[0] != n
            or any(a.shape != (n,) for a in (hold, groups, complete, start, onset, critical))):
        raise ValueError('incompatible history, time, or coupon shapes')
    if (not all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (dt, t, hist, hold, z0, x, start, critical))
            or np.any(dt < 0) or t[0] < 0 or t[-1] <= 0 or np.any(np.diff(t) <= 0)):
        raise ValueError('require finite inputs, nonnegative durations, and increasing hold times')
    if any(np.any(np.abs(a) >= yield_stress/stress_scale) for a in (hist, hold)):
        raise ValueError('applied stresses must be strictly sub-yield')
    if not np.isfinite(onset[~complete]).all():
        raise ValueError('incomplete coupons require independently measured onset')
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.] if dt.size else dt
    drift_x = np.column_stack((np.ones(n), x))
    p = 2 + drift_x.shape[1]
    units = np.r_[np.full(2, strain_scale/stress_scale), np.full(p-2, strain_scale/time_scale)]
    D = np.r_[t, 1.]

    def relaxation(q: np.ndarray, take: np.ndarray | slice) -> np.ndarray:
        memory = np.exp(-after[:, None]/q) * -np.expm1(-dt[:, None]/q)
        z = z0[take]*np.exp(-dt.sum()/q) + hist[take] @ memory
        delta = hold[take, None] - z
        kernel = np.vstack((-np.expm1(-t[:, None]/q), 1/q))
        return delta[:, None, :] * kernel

    def mad(a: np.ndarray, axis: int | None = None, floor: float = 1e-6) -> np.ndarray:
        center = np.median(a, axis=axis, keepdims=True)
        return np.maximum(floor, 1.4826*np.median(np.abs(a-center), axis=axis))

    def ordered(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
        return np.array([q[0], q[0] + q[1]*(hi-q[0])])

    if model is None:
        y = np.asarray(strain_increment, float)
        late = t >= late_time_ratio
        if (y.shape != (n, k) or not complete.any() or not late.any() or
                not np.isfinite(y[complete]).all() or not np.isfinite(onset[complete]).all()):
            raise ValueError('fitting requires complete training observations and a late horizon')
        target = np.column_stack((y[complete]/strain_scale, onset[complete]))
        X = drift_x[complete]
        drift_design = X[:, None, :]*D[None, :, None]
        lower = np.r_[lo, 1e-5, np.full(p, -np.inf)]
        upper = np.r_[hi-1e-6*(hi-lo), 1., np.full(p, np.inf)]

        def design(q: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            return np.concatenate((relaxation(q, complete), drift_design), axis=2)

        def residual(v: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
            return design(ordered(v)) @ v[2:] - target

        pilots = []
        for f, g in ((.02, .14), (.05, .36), (.12, .67)):
            a, b = lo + (hi-lo)*np.array([f, g])
            w0 = np.linalg.lstsq(design(np.array([a, b])).reshape(-1, p), target.ravel(), rcond=None)[0]
            pilots.append(least_squares(lambda v: (residual(v)/.05).ravel(),
                                        np.r_[a, (b-a)/(hi-a), w0], bounds=(lower, upper),
                                        loss='soft_l1', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=200))
        pilot = min(pilots, key=lambda fit: fit.cost)
        r = residual(pilot.x)
        seed_scale = 2.385*np.r_[np.repeat(mad(r[:, :-1]), k), mad(r[:, -1])]
        seed = least_squares(lambda v: (residual(v)/seed_scale).ravel(), pilot.x,
                             bounds=(lower, upper), loss='cauchy', x_scale='jac', max_nfev=200).x
        scale = 2.385*mad(residual(seed), axis=0)
        A = D/scale
        nz = A != 0

        def profile(v: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
            u = (target - relaxation(ordered(v), complete) @ v[2:])/scale
            drift = np.median(u[:, nz]/A[nz], axis=1)
            for _ in range(8):
                e = u - drift[:, None]*A
                weight = 1/(1+e**2)
                drift = ((weight*u) @ A)/(weight @ (A*A))
            return u-drift[:, None]*A, drift

        fit = least_squares(lambda v: profile(v)[0].ravel(), seed[:4],
                            bounds=(lower[:4], upper[:4]), loss='cauchy', max_nfev=120)
        norms = np.linalg.norm(fit.jac, axis=0)
        if not fit.success or fit.jac.shape[0] < 4 or np.any(norms == 0):
            raise ValueError('relaxation fit did not converge or is not locally identifiable')
        singular = np.linalg.svd(fit.jac/norms, compute_uv=False)
        if singular[-1] <= rank_tol*singular[0]:
            raise ValueError('relaxation parameters are not locally identifiable')
        q, compliance = ordered(fit.x), fit.x[2:]
        drift = profile(fit.x)[1]
        b0 = seed[4:]
        spread = mad(drift-X @ b0, floor=.003)
        b = least_squares(lambda v: (drift-X @ v)/spread, b0, loss='soft_l1').x
        prior = X @ b
        observed = np.median((target[:, :-1][:, late] -
                              relaxation(q, complete)[:, :-1][:, late] @ compliance)/t[late], axis=1)
        labels = np.unique(groups[complete])
        correction = np.empty((labels.size, 3))
        for j, label in enumerate(labels):
            take = groups[complete] == label
            center = np.median(prior[take])
            xg = prior[take]-center
            rg = observed[take]-prior[take]
            sg = mad(rg, floor=.003)
            if np.ptp(xg) <= np.finfo(float).eps*max(1., abs(center)):
                offset, slope = np.median(rg), 0.
            else:
                offset, slope = least_squares(lambda v: (rg-v[0]-v[1]*xg)/sg,
                                              [0., 0.], loss='soft_l1').x
            correction[j] = center, offset, slope
        w = np.r_[compliance, b]
        model = (q*time_scale, w*units, labels, correction)
    else:
        if strain_increment is not None:
            raise ValueError('supply training increments or a model, not both')
        taus, coefficients, labels, correction = model
        q, w = np.asarray(taus, float)/time_scale, np.asarray(coefficients, float)/units
        if q.shape != (2,) or not 0 < q[0] < q[1] < np.inf or w.shape != (p,):
            raise ValueError('model requires ordered physical taus and matching coefficients')

    relax = relaxation(q, slice(None)) @ w[:2]
    drift = drift_x @ w[2:]
    for label, (center, offset, slope) in zip(labels, correction):
        take = (groups == label) & complete
        drift[take] += offset + slope*(drift[take]-center)
    drift[~complete] = onset[~complete]-relax[~complete, -1]
    inc = (relax[:, :-1] + drift[:, None]*t)*strain_scale
    strain = start[:, None] + inc
    secant = inc[:, -1]/np.maximum(np.abs(hold)*stress_scale, stress_floor)
    grid = np.r_[0., np.asarray(hold_times, float)]
    curve = np.column_stack((start, strain))
    above = curve >= critical[:, None]
    event = above.any(axis=1)
    first = above.argmax(axis=1)
    crossing = np.full(n, grid[-1])
    crossing[above[:, 0]] = 0.
    rows = np.flatnonzero(first > 0)
    j = first[rows]
    left, right = curve[rows, j-1], curve[rows, j]
    crossing[rows] = grid[j-1] + (grid[j]-grid[j-1])*(critical[rows]-left)/(right-left)
    return model, strain, secant, crossing, event

def run_self_test():

    line, support = calibrate_affine(noisy, stress_scale=1.)
    assert support >= 1
    np.testing.assert_allclose(line, [1.3, -.1], atol=1e-12)
    line, support = calibrate_affine(clean[[0, -1]], stress_scale=1., prior=(.7, .2))

    np.testing.assert_allclose(line, [1.3, -.1], atol=1e-12)
    line, support = calibrate_affine(np.array([[0., .15]]), stress_scale=1., historical=(clean,))
    assert support < 1
    np.testing.assert_allclose(line, [1.3, -.1], atol=1e-12)
    scaled = np.column_stack((7+2*cmd, .01*noisy[:, 1]))
    line, support = calibrate_affine(scaled, stress_scale=.01, command_scale=2., command_origin=7.)
    assert support >= 1
    np.testing.assert_allclose((line[0]*scaled[:, 0]+line[1])/.01, clean[:, 1], atol=1e-12)

    raw = np.array([[np.nan], [0.], [0.], [3.], [np.nan], [9.]])

    lab = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1])

    aligned, complete = align_reference_features(raw, ref, lab, cell)

    np.testing.assert_array_equal(complete, [False, True, True, True, False, True])
    gain = np.where(lab == 0, 3., .25)[:, None]
    offset = np.where(lab == 0, 11., -2.)[:, None]
    order = np.array([5, 0, 3, 1, 4, 2])
    a, c = align_reference_features((gain*raw+offset)[order], (gain*ref+offset)[order],
                                    (9-2*lab)[order], cell[order])
    np.testing.assert_allclose(a, aligned[order], atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(c, complete[order])

    rng = np.random.default_rng(20)

    hold = rng.uniform(.58, .85, n)

    inc = (delta*w[:2]) @ (1-np.exp(-t[None, :]/tau[:, None])) + drift[:, None]*t
    onset = (delta*w[:2]/tau).sum(axis=1)+drift

    args = dict(time_scale=1., stress_scale=1., strain_scale=1., yield_stress=1., stress_floor=.65)
    model, pred, secant, cross, event = hereditary_creep(
        dt, t, hist, hold, z0, x, lab, np.ones(n, bool), start, onset, threshold,
        **args, strain_increment=inc)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (model[0], model[1], pred, secant, cross))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(model[0], tau, rtol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(model[1], w, atol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred, start[:, None]+inc, atol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(secant, inc[:, -1]/np.maximum(hold, .65), atol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cross, (t[5]+t[6])/2, atol=2e-4)
    assert event.all()

    complete = np.arange(n) % 3 != 0
    observed_onset = np.where(complete, np.nan, onset+.19)
    true_inc = inc + (~complete)[:, None]*.19*t
    threshold = start+(true_inc[:, 5]+true_inc[:, 6])/2
    threshold[0], threshold[1] = start[0]-1, start[1]+true_inc[1, -1]+1
    expected_cross = np.full(n, (t[5]+t[6])/2)
    expected_cross[:2] = [0., t[-1]]
    xp = np.where(complete[:, None], x, 0.)
    _, pred, secant, cross, event = hereditary_creep(
        dt, t, hist, hold, z0, xp, lab, complete, start, observed_onset, threshold, **args, model=model)
    assert all(np.isfinite(a).all() for a in (pred, secant, cross))
    np.testing.assert_allclose(pred, start[:, None]+true_inc, atol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(secant, true_inc[:, -1]/np.maximum(hold, .65), atol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cross, expected_cross, atol=2e-4)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(event, np.arange(n) != 1)

    ct, cs, ce = 2., .01, .5
    order = rng.permutation(n)
    factors = np.r_[np.full(2, ce/cs), np.full(3, ce/ct)]
    converted_model = (ct*model[0], factors*model[1], 9-2*model[2], model[3])
    _, py, sy, cy, ey = hereditary_creep(
        ct*dt, ct*t, cs*hist[order], cs*hold[order], cs*z0[order], xp[order],
        (9-2*lab)[order], complete[order], ce*start[order], ce/ct*observed_onset[order],
        ce*threshold[order], time_scale=ct, stress_scale=cs, strain_scale=ce,
        yield_stress=cs, stress_floor=cs*.65, model=converted_model)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(py/ce, pred[order], atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(sy*cs/ce, secant[order], atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(cy/ct, cross[order], atol=1e-12)
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(ey, event[order])


run_self_test()
"
}
